title: Viraddho or Āraddho
text: 2. Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā || viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || || Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā || āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || || Katame satta || Satisambojjhaṅgo || || la-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo || || 3. Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime satta bojjhaṅgā viraddhā || viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammā dukkhakkhayagāmī || || Yesaṃ kesañci bhikkhave ime satta bojjhaṅgā āraddhā || āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhagāmī ti || ||
